name: glyphdown
description: Two-register prompting convention for Claude Code: dense ASCII form for internal reasoning, normal prose for user-visible output. Deterministic codec, runs locally, no API key and no vendor account. Ships a skill and eight hooks across five events enabled on install (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PreCompact, PostToolUse), plus a lossless tool-result codec (ANSI strip + JSON minify + blank-collapse + trailing marker + data-shape guard + schema-tag prefix + break-even guard). Fail-open on every path.
